name: X7V2
direction: ROM to receiver through stock video; no return channel
bit_order: row-major cells, two bits per symbol, byte bits7..6 first
border: outermost cells use symbol (x+y)%4 as per-frame palette references; remaining non-payload ring is symbol0
manifest_payload: ASCII safe 8.3 basename, 1..12 bytes, no NUL; preserved as display/export name, never used as internal storage path
data_payload: 264 bytes except exact final remainder; zero-based block; empty files have no data blocks
identity: manifest protocol version + filename + file size + source CRC; data associated by version + size + source CRC, assuming one selected file broadcasts at a time; not collision-proof session identity
repetition: manifest before each pass and every 32 data blocks; repeat all blocks until user stops
receiver: Calibrate four YUV reference colors from the outer border; reject insufficient separation, ambiguous cells, wrong markers or CRC. Latch first valid manifest; reject conflicting manifest. Accept out-of-order blocks; identical duplicates ignored, conflicting duplicates fail. Verify complete coverage, exact file length and CRC by reading staged file before exposing verified output.
compatibility: New APK also decodes legacy X7V1 monochrome:144-byte frame,120-byte payload,8-bit length at5,zero bytes6..7,CRC at140; outer checker black iff(x+y)%2==0. New ROMs require CGB mode and emit X7V2 only. Old APKs cannot decode color ROMs.
